title: Carbon Laser Facial vs HydraFacial
h1: Carbon laser facial vs HydraFacial: which one for your skin?
desc: Carbon laser facial vs HydraFacial compared for oily skin, pores, acne and glow, with how each works, downtime and prices in Dubai.
answer: A carbon laser facial (AED 370 + VAT for the face) suits oily skin, enlarged pores and blackheads because the laser lifts away oil and gently heats the skin to calm oil glands. HydraFacial (from AED 199 + VAT) suits hydration and a gentle deep clean. For oily, congested skin many people alternate them monthly.
body:
## How they differ

HydraFacial uses vortex suction and serums to cleanse, extract and hydrate. The carbon laser uses a carbon lotion and a Q-switched laser to lift oil and debris and warm the deeper skin. One nourishes, the other clarifies and refines.

## Which to choose

- Shiny T-zone, large pores: carbon laser
- Dull, tight or dehydrated skin: HydraFacial
- Acne-prone and congested: HydraFacial Gold, or alternate both
- Before an event: either, one to three days before

## Combining them

Alternating every 2 weeks, or pairing them in a package, controls oil while keeping the skin hydrated.
faq: Can I do both on the same day?
Usually they're spaced out, but ask us about combined plans.
HydraFacial Gold for congestion; carbon laser for oiliness. Active acne needs a doctor's plan.
